Q: R studio keeps getting aborted A:

I have MacOS 12.7.6, R 4.5.2, and with RStudio 2024.09.1+394 i always got the fatal error message. I updated to RStudio 2025.09.1+401 which is for MacOS 13 (not sure how I'm able to do this with MacOS12.7.6) but it worked.

Q: Conditional lag and retention A:

You need to add a mre and really this should be a standard question, not a discussion question - unless you want to discuss multiple options.

Q: Filtering Users with a globalscope A:

It looks like you are using this global scope on the User model.

When you call auth()->user(), it internally calls User::find(auth()->id()). Using auth()->user() within a global scope causes an infinite recursive call.

To avoid this, use a query builder instead of auth()->user() in the global scope, like this:

$user = \DB::table('users')->where('id', auth()->id())->first();

Q: Error Could not find an installed version of Gradle either in Android Studio, or on your system A:

I moved Android folder path to another path and taked this error.

I resolved to this problem in below.

I was changed to Gradle path in system variables. But not path in user variables. You must change to path in system variables
